description: This file declares classes and functions related to importing and resolving source code within the Torch JIT compiler, including SourceImporter and SourceImporterImpl classes, for handling TorchScript source dependencies.

classes.name: SourceImporterImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for importing and resolving source code dependencies within Torch JIT.

classes.name: SourceImporter
classes.description: Main class for loading types and importing methods from serialized TorchScript sources, managing dependencies between source files.

methods.name: SourceImporterImpl::findNamedType
methods.description: Finds a named type within the source importer context.

methods.name: SourceImporterImpl::findFunction
methods.description: Finds a function by name within the source importer context.

methods.name: SourceImporterImpl::parseSourceIfNeeded
methods.description: Parses source code if it has not been parsed yet.

methods.name: SourceImporterImpl::LEGACY_import_methods
methods.description: Imports methods from a source into a module.

methods.name: SourceImporterImpl::resolveValue
methods.description: Resolves a value in the source context.

methods.name: SourceImporter::loadType
methods.description: Loads a type given its qualified name.

methods.name: SourceImporter::LEGACY_import_methods
methods.description: Imports methods from source into a module.
